chunks: (For) those who persevere and place their trust in their Lord.
ai.seo_question: What are the key spiritual qualities of those who persevere and trust in God according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Ahl al-Bayt, particularly Imam Ali and Imam Husayn, who exemplified perfect sabr (patience) and tawakkul (trust) during their trials. The combination of active endurance and spiritual reliance underscores the balance between human effort and divine decree, a key theme in understanding the status of the Imams as the perfect models of faith.
